canonical_summary: Escarole is a plant mentioned in market gardening practices in Paris; it has characteristics similar to chicories and is also known as curled-leaf or round-leaf endive. There are several varieties of escarole, but one variety is often grown for its fat and plump leaves that make less tough salads.
